findings.title: Discovery CSV balance_display remains empty for non-Dash adapter results without balanceUnit
findings.reproduction: Pass current Bitcoin/Ethereum finding shapes (balanceAtomic bigint and BTC/ETH balanceLabel, without balanceUnit) to the production createRecoveryExport(..., 'csv') entry point; the audit harness tests synthetic public-shaped values.
findings.expected: balance_display contains the exact decimal amount for every supported coin.
findings.observed: findingBalanceDisplay formats balanceAtomic only when balanceUnit is set, then falls back to numericDash, which recognizes only a DASH suffix. Both BTC and ETH display cells are empty.
findings.impact: The generic CSV display column is blank for those coin findings. Exact atomic value and unit metadata are preserved, so the value is not corrupted.
findings.evidence: AUD-020-evidence/historical-api-regressions-final.log (local), two cases; current Bitcoin/Ethereum constructors and exporter source.
findings.recommendedFix: Populate balanceUnit in each adapter or require exact unit-aware formatting in the shared exporter; do not infer units from display labels.
findings.requiredVerification: Active-path Bitcoin and Ethereum adapter result tests, exact atomic-value preservation, and a synthetic future-asset case.

findings.title: README smoke-matrix count is stale: 66 documented, 70 planned and compiled
findings.reproduction: Compare README's 66-build statement with pnpm build:matrix:smoke:plan and pnpm build:matrix:smoke.
findings.expected: Documentation matches current smoke coverage or avoids a hard-coded count.
findings.observed: Planner reports 70 and the compiler successfully compiles 70 variants.
findings.impact: Users and reviewers cannot reconcile documented build coverage with current build output.
findings.recommendedFix: Update to 70 or use count-free wording and derive coverage from the planner.
findings.requiredVerification: Re-run planner and smoke and compare the documented scope/count.

findings.title: v0.1.5 release notes describe a stable release that is still a release candidate
findings.reproduction: Compare stable Released claims and v0.1.5 tag links with the public GitHub release list captured at 2026-10-01T19:49:13Z.
findings.expected: Release status/date describes an actually published stable tag or is clearly identified as draft/preparation text.
findings.observed: README says stable v0.1.5 was released on 2026-09-17; both notes say Released 2026-10-01; public GitHub listed v0.1.5-rc.1 as prerelease and v0.1.4 as stable latest.
findings.impact: Readers may mistake preparation notes for an already published stable release or follow an unpublished stable tag link.
findings.evidence: AUD-020-evidence/public-releases.log (local) and the three source documents.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep the requested version v0.1.5; mark release status as draft/preparation until stable publication, then state the actual publication date.
findings.requiredVerification: After publication, confirm stable release/tag and note date/tag agreement.

findings.title: Security audit overview points to AUD-018 as the latest retained review
findings.reproduction: Compare SECURITY_AUDIT.md's latest-review paragraph with the audit index and AUD-019 pair.
findings.expected: The overview identifies the latest full audit and distinguishes it from the latest focused review.
findings.observed: It calls AUD-018 the latest retained review and AUD-017 the latest API review, omitting the AUD-019 full audit of all tools.
findings.impact: Security reviewers are directed to stale audit status and may miss newer findings and limitations.

remediation.fixCommitNote: The display column has used each finding's balanceUnit since a323587; the common history step assigns the adapter's amountUnit to every finding, whether or not history loads.
remediation.evidence: apps/discovery-scanner/tests/export-balance-units.test.ts: the real Bitcoin and Ethereum adapters, the history step with history unavailable, then the CSV export give 0.12345678 BTC and 0.000000000012345678 ETH with exact atomic values and units; a synthetic future adapter with an unparsed label gives 12345.678 FUT; without the history step the test fails. The AUD-020 reproduction built results by hand without that step; such objects still show an empty cell, by design, because the exporter does not infer units from labels.
README describes the smoke matrix without a count and names pnpm build:matrix:smoke:plan for its size; the planner reports 70.

README and both v0.1.5 notes say v0.1.5 is in preparation and v0.1.5-rc.1 is published; the Dash note no longer links the unpublished tag. At publication of v0.1.5 the date and the tag link must be set; that step is part of the release, not of this remediation.
SECURITY_AUDIT.md names AUD-020 as the latest retained review and AUD-019 as the full audit before it, and keeps AUD-018 as the latest focused review.
Both guides formatted (table padding only); pnpm format and format:check now include Markdown outside docs/audits; pnpm format:check passes.
